coordinate_units: Unchanged source numeric units; no mesh position correction.

profile_evidence.basis: Neither pipeline candidate fits this rig's inverse binds inside the 0.002 tolerance (full 0.00306, SSC0 0.00205), but the misfit is confined to three right-arm joints (RT_loarm, RT_loarm_end, RT_wrist): RT_uparm and RT_loarm carry authored rest scales of about 0.3 percent away from 1 (RT_uparm 1.0032, 0.9992, 0.9992; RT_loarm 0.9978, 0.9998, 1.0008), and every other joint, including the whole mirrored left arm, fits to 1e-5. Solving each joint's local matrix from the parent's stored inverse bind shows the bit-0 joints use local basis R * diag(S / parent S): the parent scale is divided out between the rotation and the joint's own scale. That reading fits every joint of this rig (worst 3.1e-7), whereas the pipeline's SSC0 order (diag(1 / parent S) * R * S) leaves 0.002 on RT_loarm and its descendants. The same bit-0-gated reading fits all 539 character-folder models that carry inverse binds (worst 1.5e-5, joints with bit 0 clear and a non-unit parent are fitted only without compensation), and it separates itself from default SSC0 on amb_glow_slug as well (SSC0 0.00125, this reading 1e-6). It is what the profile selects.
profile_evidence.consistency: The rule is the bit-0 parent-scale compensation already used by the pipeline, with only the operand order changed. The two orders are identical for uniform parent scale and differ only where a parent has non-uniform scale and the rotation does not commute with it, so this profile cannot alter any other model.
profile_evidence.scope: Rest-pose evidence only: the rule is established by the model's inverse binds, not by a trace of the runtime evaluator, and the same local composition is assumed for animated samples. The idle clip animates scale on the head, jaw and spine, so the operand order moves its pose (largest world-matrix difference against default SSC0 about 0.21 on the tongue chain). Counter-evidence for animated poses: under this rule the idle, walk and fidget loops shear the bit-0 joint bases (largest column cosine 0.08 to 0.33) where SSC0 keeps them orthogonal, and React_Death reaches condition number 2.0e4 against 151 under SSC0, which is why this order is not the default for any other rig (see docs/pipeline.md, Inheritance rule). The per-frame evaluator may therefore differ from the reference-pose builder this rule reproduces.
